description: Change the SUBSCRIPTION plan (admin only). No argument lists the monthly plans. Each plan leads with what it is for. Every paid plan (Starter, Pro, Studio) includes Autopilot, unlimited posting and scheduling, monthly credits and no markup on models on every credit including extra packs; Starter is also the plan for someone who only posts and schedules. Basic is no longer sold (existing subscribers keep it): never offer it. The no-argument listing gives each plan's live price, monthly credits and sites (unlimited pages and landing pages on each site, so a business can keep every landing page on one); quote prices from it, never from memory. Every paid plan posts without a limit (Free: up to 10 posts on 3 channels). New subscriber: a Checkout URL for the human. Existing subscriber upgrading: a quote + quote_token; once the human agrees, call again with confirm:true and quote_token to charge the card on file. Downgrade: a billing-page link; it starts at the term's end.

confirm.description: true (with quote_token) to make a quoted upgrade

plan.description: the plan id to move to (e.g. pro) — omit to list the available plans first

quote_token.description: the quoteToken from the quote step
